decision_reason: The paired five-fork experiment preserved complete evidence and decoded event content, but the confidence interval for lambda-copy minus immutable-factory includes zero. The immutable factory remains the ordinary direct-decoder construction for its simpler immutable ownership semantics, but it is not claimed as a measured speed improvement.
